command: pnpm run test:receipt && pnpm run audit:safety

unsafeCapability: no transaction-submission API in project source
no funded-key environment access in project source
no credential-shaped literals in project source
no wallet-injection access in project source
no external runtime network or peer API in application source
the only verification-network exception is a hard-coded 127.0.0.1 client probe

expectedOutcomes.outcome: reject before SIDECARS_MATCHED and emit no reconstruction/decryption claim
restore manifest order only after commitment-derived versioned-hash matching

expectedOutcomes.case: corrupt batch, entry, field prefix, tag, or ciphertext
expectedOutcomes.outcome: reject at the failing integrity stage and never emit DECRYPTED
reject canonical batch parsing and emit no entry-verified state
fail closed before persistence or cryptographic success evidence
discard the invalid state or bounded inbox without broad storage deletion
restore only allowlisted bounded state and retain no key or wallet authority
